create_SimpleAlohaAgent: create a SimpleAlohaAgent instance with an EventBus and AgentFrameworkConfig to control a dual-arm Aloha robot
configure_system_prompt: configure the SimpleAlohaAgent system prompt with meow mode, dry run, and scene description options via AgentFrameworkConfig
get_sd_tool: get a SubtaskSuccessDetectorV4 vision success detection tool for a given SDToolName flag
get_all_tools: get all ToolUseConfig entries including run_instruction_until_done and optional scene description tools for the agent
connect_agent: connect the SimpleAlohaAgent and its optional audio handler to the event bus asynchronously
